_about: Low-voltage network and transformer parameters for pilot feeder F07. Read by matlab/run_f07.m and by src/gridsetu/lvnetwork.py (the Python cross-check). Every value carries its source or derivation in the matching _src field. ASSUMPTION marks a value chosen by us, not taken from a datasheet.
_base_kva_src: Transformer rating. 315 kVA is the nearest IS 1180 standard rating to the simulator's 300 kW limit (315 kVA x 0.95 pf = 299 kW).
_v_nominal_ll_v_src: ASSUMPTION: 415 V line-to-line / 240 V phase, the nominal LT supply voltage used by Indian DISCOMs. Voltages are reported in per unit of this value.
_v_limit_pu_src: ASSUMPTION pending confirmation of the Tamil Nadu supply-code clause: +/-6 % of nominal, the commonly quoted Indian LT limit (energypedia.info/wiki/Permissible_Voltage_Drop).

transformer._src: WBSEDCL technical specification, 3-star 315 kVA 11/0.433 kV distribution transformer to IS 1180 (Part 1):2014 Level 2: impedance 4.5 %; maximum total losses 1025 W at 50 % load and 3100 W at 100 % load. Solving NLL + 0.25 LL = 1025 and NLL + LL = 3100 gives LL = 2766.7 W, NLL = 333.3 W.
transformer._rise_src: Same specification: temperature rise limits 35 C top oil (thermometer), 40 C winding (resistance method).

thermal._src: IEC 60076-7 recommended thermal characteristics for distribution transformers, ONAN (exponents, time constants, hot-spot factor). ASSUMPTION until checked against a copy of the standard: values as commonly cited for that column.
thermal._hotspot_gradient_src: ASSUMPTION/derived: H x g_r, with g_r = winding average rise 40 K - average oil rise (0.8 x 35 K = 28 K) = 12 K, H = 1.1.
thermal._ageing_src: IEC 60076-7 relative ageing rate for non-thermally-upgraded paper: V = 2^((theta_h - 98)/6).

line.conductor: LT aerial bunched cable 3x95 + 16 + 70 mm2 (XLPE, aluminium)
line._choice_src: CEA, Guidelines for distribution (overhead vs underground): aerial bunched cable is recommended for congested urban lanes and theft-prone areas, which describes this peri-urban feeder. ASSUMPTION: the feeder has been reconductored to ABC; the earlier bare-conductor layout is kept as a sensitivity (line_bare_acsr_rabbit).
line._r_src: MSEDCL technical specification CE/T&QC/MSC-I/A.B CABLE/2019 (IS 14255), Table 1: 95 mm2 phase conductor, maximum DC resistance 0.320 ohm/km at 20 C.
line._r_op_src: Derived: 0.320 x (1 + 0.00403 x (50 - 20)). ASSUMPTION: 50 C average conductor temperature.
line._x_src: Derived: 2 pi 50 x 2e-7 x ln(GMD/GMR) per metre; GMR = 0.7788 x 5.5 mm (11.0 mm conductor, MSEDCL Table 1); GMD = 16 mm. ASSUMPTION: bunched phases about one insulated diameter apart.

neutral_messenger._src: MSEDCL specification Table 1: 70 mm2 aluminium-alloy messenger (also the neutral), maximum DC resistance 0.492 ohm/km at 20 C (IS 398 Part IV).

line_bare_acsr_rabbit._r_src: Apar Industries ACSR datasheet, Rabbit: DC resistance 0.54260 ohm/km at 20 C.
line_bare_acsr_rabbit._r_op_src: Derived: 0.5426 x (1 + 0.00403 x (50 - 20)). ASSUMPTION: 50 C average conductor temperature.
line_bare_acsr_rabbit._x_src: Derived: 2 pi 50 x 2e-7 x ln(GMD/GMR) per metre; GMR = 0.7788 x 5.025 mm; GMD = (0.3 x 0.3 x 0.6)^(1/3) m. ASSUMPTION: 0.3 m spacing on a horizontal LT cross-arm.
line_bare_acsr_rabbit._note: Sensitivity only: the earlier assumed bare-conductor layout. Gives voltage outside +/-6 % in 93 % to over 99 % of steps.

topology._src: ASSUMPTION: three radial circuits of about 600 m from the transformer, seven equal segments each. Same layout as outputs/matlab/f07_buses.csv.

_load_power_factor_src: ASSUMPTION: 0.95 lagging for household and enterprise load; battery and community PV at unity power factor.

gridsetu_distributed._note: Same total battery and community PV, split equally across the middle bus of each circuit instead of the transformer bus.
